summary: Every acceptance criterion has delivered work behind it: V01/V03 are re-checks of pre-planning work, V02/V06/V17 are P1 (D44 amended, D63-D65), V04/V05 P2, V21 P3 (amended by the mid-run ruling), V10-V12 P4, V13 P5, V14 P6, V16/V19 P7, V07-V09 P8, V18-V20 P9 (N3 records why the handover flip has no note: the step is gone), V22/V23 follow from P2, P3 and no HelmCharts commit, and V15/V24 are owed after the operator's switch (A1, A2). No done-record admits an owed leftover, and no phase depends on something nothing produced. P9's review residue in files the slice touched is fixed (Ansible ca536a6; AnsibleSpecs 150fb1a for S6's links), and S6, S26, S27 and S28 are struck. S25, the step-ca day-zero step 7 omission, is a real procedure gap and not mechanical. The reviewer rated it Minor advisory, so it stays a close-out entry, noted with the facts a fix needs.
